scenes.ss-r5-l1-b: A young capybara artist, a hedgehog and an old turtle preparing a quiet shadow-puppet festival in a seaside village hall. A small lamp casts a beautiful paper fish shadow on a white cloth, ocean dusk through open windows, tender magical realism, welcoming gentle animal characters.
scenes.ss-r5-l2-a: A determined twenty-year-old Asian woman courier without wings holding a polished metal signal mirror on a steep mountain path, a young repairman beside a wooden beacon. A chain of tiny reflected lights crosses snowy mountains to a distant school, winter storm coming.
scenes.ss-r5-l2-b: Two adult Asian university club leaders, a twenty-two-year-old woman with paper lantern plans and a twenty-four-year-old man with a short beard and a model walkway, standing beneath handmade paper lanterns near an old public reading room. Warm tentative romance with clear personal space, autumn campus at blue hour.
scenes.ss-r5-l3-a: A twenty-eight-year-old Asian woman coastal surveyor with a compass and two adult companions on a deserted island, retreating from a white sand shore toward an abandoned weather station with a rusty bell. An eerie blue beacon shines far away, rising surf and storm light, mystery and survival.
scenes.ss-r5-l3-b: A twenty-seven-year-old Asian woman community storyteller holding a brass key and a twenty-nine-year-old Asian male repair-club leader holding a different key, standing together in an old railway hall adapted as a small community stage. Warm stage spotlights and woodworking tools, adult slow romance, equal confident protagonists.
scenes.ss-r5-l4-a: Five adult Asian teammates led by a thirty-two-year-old female bus dispatcher crossing a futuristic simulated city block as a team. Multiple branching illuminated transit routes and a gate with five glowing signature panels, urban puzzle adventure, neon purple and cyan, dynamic composition.
scenes.ss-r5-l4-b: A thirty-year-old Taiwanese woman in a 1996 family photography studio, holding two translucent film negatives toward a warm desk lamp. Analog cameras, wooden cabinets and old family photographs, rain on the harbor street outside, nostalgic amber and dusty teal, no modern smartphones.
scenes.ss-r5-l5-a: A thirty-one-year-old woman surveyor Iona studying tide marks on a harbor clock tower with a brass measuring instrument. Vast imaginary coastal city Kelshore at dusk, exposed tidal flats with tiny people crossing, ominous incoming ocean, copper circuitry in the open tower, maritime political mystery.
scenes.ss-r5-l5-b: Two adult East Asian men, a boundary guard and a mirror restorer, in a sealed mountain trial temple eleven years after a disappearance. One cracked bronze mirror holds a faint frozen silhouette; ash drifts over weathered stone name tablets. Original xianxia mystery, tense partnership, dark jade and silver.
scenes.ss-r5-l6-a: A thirty-three-year-old female royal investigator Serin Ash in a restrained dark cloak in the hearing room of an imaginary kingdom. Seven witness statements on a large oak desk, one ghostly pale sheet beside a mechanical recorder, smoke from a burned archive outside high windows, regal amber and burgundy mystery.
scenes.ss-r5-l6-b: A thirty-six-year-old Asian woman engineer Nora outside a renovated old print workshop at dusk, fastening a new blank brass nameplate on her own door. An adult male collaborator stands respectfully nearby with a prototype flood-alert light. Strong independent heroine, warm windows against a stormy harbor city, sophisticated hopeful adult romance.
